pages.text: $(thing)Feedback$()$(br2)Measure what a machine does, compare it with what it should do, and push it back by the difference. Every thermostat works this way.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Rate Table.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A machine multiplies what goes in by G; what comes out is scaled by H and taken away from what goes in. Write the overall gain T, out over in.
